title: Graph-aware brainstorming context
description: Orchestrator greps a fresh knowledge graph for feature keywords at the 'Explore project context' step to seed brainstorming with pre-built node names, summaries, and edges.

title: Post-land knowledge graph refresh gate
description: After a merge or PR finish, the orchestrator freshness-checks the graph, presents a human yes/no gate, and dispatches a worker to rebuild the graph on confirmation.

title: Workflow diagram updated
description: Add a ◆ D dispatch node after D19 in the phase E diagram and an ○ inline note at the brainstorming collect step in docs/orchestrator-workflow.md.

feature: Single observation path for worker dispatch
title: Pre-dispatch rescue-doc read
description: Orchestrator reads the provider's rescue doc (flag surface, effort enum, model aliases, plugin root, profile policy) before building the command string; caches per provider per session.

feature: Single observation path for worker dispatch
title: dispatch-worker.mjs wrapper and stdout contract
description: Node.js wrapper script owns the spawn-wait-classify-extract cycle and prints exactly one TERMINAL or PENDING line; always exits 0; supports --job resume flag.

feature: Single observation path for worker dispatch
title: Haiku forwarder subagent
description: Thin haiku subagent with four-line instruction: run the given command, return TERMINAL verbatim, re-run RESUME on PENDING. Composes no flags and reads no files.

feature: Single observation path for worker dispatch
title: Crash safety via turn-N-job.txt
description: Script writes turn-N-job.txt immediately after job-id is returned from task --background and before any status --wait call, enabling recovery after session death.

feature: Single observation path for worker dispatch
title: Script-bounded PENDING loop
description: Script enforces a maximum wall-clock limit (default 60 minutes, flag-overridable) by comparing elapsed time against job createdAt; emits TERMINAL failed timeout instead of another PENDING when exceeded.

feature: Single observation path for worker dispatch
title: Dispatch-agent Steps 4–5 rewrite
description: Step 4 gains sub-steps 4a (read rescue doc), 4b (build command string), 4c (invoke haiku). Step 5 receive collapses to reading the path in the TERMINAL line with no status/result slash-command calls.

feature: Single observation path for worker dispatch
title: Claude worker TERMINAL alignment
description: One line added to the claude dispatch prompt so workers finish by returning TERMINAL <status> <path>, making the orchestrator's receive logic identical across Codex, Antigravity, and claude.
